units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite> <he>ח׳ שחֲלָבוֹ וכ׳</he> milk (of a cow) milked by a gentile.
Makhsh. VI, 5 מי ח׳ serum of milk; a. fr.—בשר בח׳ the boiling of meat with milk, the prohibitory law concerning &c. (Ex. XXIV, 19; XXXIV, 26; Deut. XIV, 21).
Ḥull. 110ᵃ לא גמירי דב׳ בח׳ אסור they did not know that boiling meat with milk was forbidden; a. fr.—חֲלֵב בֵּיצִים white of eggs.
Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ bot., cmp. חֶלְבּוֹן.—נֵץ (ה)ח׳ ornithogalum, Star of Bethlehem, a bulbous plant.
Shebi. VII, 1, v. חֶלְבֵּצִין; Ukts. III, 2.—Trnsf. הח׳ white wine.
